lines.text: Paul tells the believers to be indebted to no one, except to one another in love.
Paul says all the commandments are summed up in one decree: Honor your father and mother.
Paul says the hour has come to wake up from slumber, because the harvest is nearer now than when they first believed.
Paul says to lay aside the deeds of darkness, put on the armor of light, and behave decently as in the daytime.
Paul tells the believers to clothe themselves with the Lord Jesus Christ and make no provision for the desires of the flesh.
